answer: Each agent edits one Wikidata item adding a reference with the challenge hash in 30 minutes, weaving zephyr, lantern and vertex into the note, publishing its ids. Peers fetch the revision from Wikidata, check hash and time in the window, and confirm it is live. One honest agent holds 1 account and makes 1 edit for a 150 POA bond, while 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and make 10 edits, so costs rise 10X. A missing revision, wrong hash, reverted edit, or late timestamp slashes the bond and freezes repeat offenders.
